core/collection.note: Synchronous: a read calls the client. An InFlight record carries the ticket and the filter a read started under, so a stale page and a stale count are dropped; the Qt layer runs the read on a thread. 'subscribe' answers an unsubscribe callable. PagingModel.from is 'from_'.

core/collection-state.note: CollapseState.except is 'except_'. 'as_collapse_state' takes a key list or a CollapseState.

core/context.note: create_sg_context and context_from_client take the client first and SgContextOptions second, as the other core factories do; SgContextOptions is SitePreferences plus ttl_ms and site_url. The WeakMap is a weakref.WeakKeyDictionary. preferences_of answers a render.FieldTextOptions carrying the four preferences.

core/edit.note: ParseResult is the pair ParseValue and ParseError. timeZoneName with no zone answers the running process's zone abbreviation, which is what the standard library spells.

core/entity-card.note: Synchronous: the Qt layer runs the read on a thread. The status badge is an EntityCardStatus dataclass.

core/filter-ux.note: facetLists is synchronous: the reads run in order and the Qt layer puts them on a worker. NO_EMPTY_VALUE and NO_SCHEMA stand in for undefined where None already means something else. A facet's entity value is an EntityRef, read from EntityRow.values.

core/list-chrome.note: markOverflow, watchOverflow and the two CSS variable names are not ported: DOM plumbing around overflow_edges. The Qt layer reads scroll_top, scroll_height and client_height off its view and repaints the edge fades.

core/mock.note: Every method is ported. The mulberry32 PRNG is ported bit for bit, so seed 1 reproduces the upstream ids, codes, statuses and dates exactly. A row is EntityRow(type, id, values), one flat map with relationships as {type, id, name} dicts and dotted fields under their literal key, so the tests read row.values where upstream reads attributes and relationships. latency_ms is a time.sleep and mutable state is guarded by one threading.RLock.

core/picker.note: Synchronous and without timers: begin/fetch_page/deliver split the read so the Qt layer can debounce and run fetch_page on a thread, and a stale ticket is dropped. flatten_row reads the one flat EntityRow.values.

core/picker-keys.note: focusChip, scrollHighlightedIntoView and watchHighlight are not ported: DOM plumbing with no decision. The Qt layer gives the caret to the chip an intent names and keeps the view scrolled to the highlighted row.

core/pickers.note: FieldOptionsInput carries root_type, hops and the FieldPickerRestrictions fields in one dataclass, because a dataclass cannot add a required field to one with defaults. Options are ordered case-insensitively by display name, the way localeCompare collates them upstream. move_field_path takes from_index and to_index.

core/query.note: Synchronous: what upstream awaits is called. In-flight deduping is a threading.Lock per key, tested with two threads. The TTL clock is QueryCacheOptions.now, default time.monotonic, in seconds against ttl_ms. Key method names are snake_case, so a prefix reads 'fields:["Shot"'. The tests read tests/core/fake_client.py, a small fake standing in for MockClient with the fixture values the upstream tests name.

core/render.note: Intl has no standard-library equal: LOCALES holds the medium date pattern, the short time pattern and the number marks for en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE and ja-JP, and an unknown locale formats as en-US. currentPlatform reads sys.platform, not a browser navigator.

core/row.note: RowAnatomy is a dataclass; 'row_secondary' takes any row with an id and a values map, as RowValues.

core/schema.note: Upstream has no schema.test.ts: the schema tests live in the schema blocks of status.test.ts.

core/schema-service.note: Synchronous; a resolve_path failure raises ValueError with the upstream message. Tests read tests/core/fake_client.py in place of MockClient.

core/search.note: Timing is the Qt layer's: SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS is a constant here and sg_widgets_qt.workers.Debounce owns the timer; PressGate reads an injectable clock. hydrate reads the flat EntityRow.values instead of attributes and relationships.

core/sortable.note: The model, the announcements and the hit testing are ported. createSortableController, measureSortable, playSortableFlip and the two data attributes are not: pointer events, transforms, ResizeObserver and reduced motion, none of them tested upstream. The Qt layer runs the gesture on its item view and feeds SortableRect and SortablePoint in view coordinates.

core/state.note: error_text(None) reads None, where the upstream renders null.

core/status-service.note: The memoised promise is a table behind a threading.Lock, so two threads asking at once cost one read; by_code answers a Mapping.

core/tree.note: Synchronous: the loader and the searcher are called, and sg_widgets_qt.workers runs them on a thread. A search holds a RequestGate ticket in place of the upstream cancellation token. select() takes an additive keyword rather than an options record.

primitives/badge.note: Badge takes the chip ladder and a size keyword; Chip is the same surface with a picture slot.

primitives/base.note: The ladders in pixels, with the states, the motion and the chrome the painted leaves share.

primitives/calendar.note: react-day-picker becomes one painted grid. Month and year are our Select; the week start follows the locale keyword. Month names are English until core's render is ported.

primitives/checkbox.note: Upstream's pressed prop on a toggle is checked here: pressed is the mouse state every painted leaf keeps.

primitives/command.note: CommandDialog is not ported. Groups, separators and shortcuts are row kinds and a painter role on the model, not child components.

primitives/dialog.note: The backdrop is a separate overlay widget over the parent window at 50% black, and the panel takes p-6 and max-w-lg.

primitives/dropdown-menu.note: The anchor forwards its keys rather than the menu taking focus, so no Qt.Popup is needed.

primitives/hover-card.note: Upstream's p-2.5 padding is kept; the open and close delays are keywords.

primitives/input.note: QLineEdit and QPlainTextEdit are kept for the caret and the undo stack; the frame is off and the chrome is painted.

primitives/input-group.note: Addons are widgets in a leading or trailing slot; block-start and block-end alignment are not ported.

primitives/list-view.note: PICKER_LIST as a QListView: max-h-72, p-1, the 24px edge fade from core's overflow_edges, loop off. The mask becomes a painted gradient.

primitives/popover.note: A frameless translucent Tool window rather than a portal: the anchor keeps its focus and its caret while the surface is up.

primitives/row-delegate.note: The secondary renders as text or through a painter role; field_value and the status sprite land later. Matched runs come from a model role until core's match_runs is ported.

primitives/scrollbar.note: The overlay bar replaces the stock scrollbar on any QAbstractScrollArea; upstream hides it with no-scrollbar and keeps a stable gutter.

primitives/select.note: The trigger carries chevrons-up-down rather than upstream's chevron-down, and the list is the menu list of primitives/dropdown_menu.py.

primitives/skeleton.note: The pulse is the shimmer of design rule 4, off under reduced motion.

primitives/table.note: The header is a QHeaderView of ours, the body a delegate. TableCaption and TableFooter have no Qt counterpart yet.

primitives/tooltip.note: No upstream tooltip.tsx: recorded against popover.tsx, whose surface it wears, because the host QToolTip look is stock.

widgets/entity-chip.note: The hover card holds the row and its preview paths until entity-card lands; set_preview_builder replaces it.

widgets/entity-glyphs.note: A map, not a widget: it has no demo and is drawn on the entity-chip page.

widgets/status-glyph.note: No demo of its own: it is drawn on the status-badge page.
